title: Scratchboard
look: White lines scratched out of a black board: the light is what was taken away.

doc.essence: A board coated in black ink, worked with a blade: every light in the picture is a line scraped back to the white clay underneath.
doc.notIt: Not engraving (white on black, light carved out of dark), not neon (scraped lines, no glow, no colour), not chalkboard (pure black, crisp blade lines, no green board).
doc.shapes: A thin white scraped edge on every part. Inside, white lines that are closer together where the area was lighter, each part at its own angle.
doc.colour: Only black and white. Very dark areas stay unscratched black.
doc.eyes: Solid white, scraped clean, so the face reads first.
pitfalls: Dense white lines around the eyes drown them: the line gap never drops below 3 px.
Mascots with very dark palettes become a white outline only: that is correct.
